text:
incident-bot: @maya (oncall) PAGED — smart-routing: repeated fallback/variant negotiation failures observed for customer: acme-payments. Severity: P1.

maya (oncall): seeing elevated errors and latency for ACME's production traffic. 5xxs spike ~10m ago. dashboards show oscillating routing counts between eu-west and us-east.

eva (runtime): logs show model negotiation failures: client requests asking for tool-calling-capable model, but routed to quantized fp16 variant that lacks tool interface => runtime returns 400/unsupported toolcall. sample log: 

```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR negotiation: model_variant_mismatch "requested=redwood-tool-v2" "served=redwood-tool-q4_0" "error=tool_calls_not_supported"
```

maya (oncall): confirmed. Customer reports lots of aborted transactions. Ben, are they impacted on multiple regions?

ben (support): yes - customer support ticket 34591: "payments failing intermittently, sometimes returns 'tool unsupported' and sometimes times out". Reported start ~09:10 UTC. They see retries from their client leading to higher latency.

toby (sre): metrics: request_rate stable, but error_rate doubled and p95 latency spiked from 180ms to 1.2s. smart-routing metrics: route handoffs count increased 7x, fallback loops detected between variant groups A <-> B.

kiran (routing): pulling fallback policy for acme-payments. policy: 

```
policies.acme-payments.fallbacks = [
  {region: "eu-west", variants: ["redwood-tool-v2", "redwood-tool-q4_0"], priority: 0},
  {region: "us-east", variants: ["redwood-tool-q4_0", "redwood-tool-v2"], priority: 1}
]
```

kiran (routing): looks like priority ordering overlaps and variant compatibility not checked. When eu-west capacity tightens it falls back to q4_0 in us-east, but negotiation filters then route it back to eu-west because toolcalls required and only v2 supports them => loop.

maya (oncall): we need immediate mitigation. Options: 1) Pin acme to redwood-tool-v2 (force no quant fallback), 2) disable cross-region fallback for this tenant, 3) enable on-the-fly compatibility check in routing (risky). Which is fastest?

eva (runtime): fastest is pinning tenant to v2 until root fixed. I can push tenant pin in ~3m. That will prevent q4_0 from being selected and stop errors.

toby (sre): I can also flip routing flag to disable cross-region fallback for that tenant. Takes ~2m. Both are fine; recommend doing both for safety.

maya (oncall): do both. Eva pin + Toby flip. Also throttle retries at the gateway to reduce amplification. Ben, can you message the customer and escalate SLA?

ben (support): on it. Sending initial note: "We're aware, isolating to variant negotiation, applying temporary pin and routing change; expecting reduced errors in ~5m. Will follow up with timeline and RCA."

pagerduty-bot: maya acknowledged the page at 09:15:04 UTC.

eva (runtime): applying tenant pin: 

```
POST /admin/tenants/acme-payments/pin
{
  "model_variant": "redwood-tool-v2",
  "reason": "mitigation - toolcall mismatch",
  "ttl": "3h"
}
```

... response 200. pinned.

maya (oncall): confirmed config pushed.

toby (sre): disabling cross-region fallback for tenant: 

```
PATCH /routing/tenants/acme-payments
{
  "cross_region_fallback": false,
  "reason": "mitigation - oscillation"
}
```

... response 200.

maya (oncall): watching metrics now.

(2m pass)

toby (sre): errors dropping. 5xxs down 80%, p95 latency down to 220ms. fallback handoffs stopped.

ben (support): customer confirms reduced failures. They still saw some timeouts due to prior retries. Asking for timeline.

kiran (routing): quick root cause summary: fallback policy allowed mixing variants without compatibility predicates; routing engine did not verify tool-call capability before selecting fallback variant. Combined with region priority inversion this caused repeated handoffs when runtime rejected toolcalls from q4 variants.

maya (oncall): immediate actions done. Next: postmortem items and longer-term fixes. Assign owners:
- kiran -> routing policy validation: ensure fallback policies include variant capability constraints + validation on write.
- eva -> runtime negotiation: return clearer error codes and emit metric "negotiation_failure_reason:tool_support" (if not already).
- toby -> add circuit-breaker in smart-routing to detect oscillation and break with safe fallback (serve error or route to warm standby).
- product/eng -> review model catalog metadata to include explicit capability flags (tool_calls, max_context_len, quant_enabled).

maya (oncall): also recommended: add a safeguard so tenants with critical transactions cannot be auto-fallbacked to quant variants that lack required features. Kiran, add as high priority.

kiran (routing): acknowledged, will triage and create PR for policy schema + validation tests. ETA: EOD.

ben (support): creating follow-up ticket to update customer with timeline and postmortem once known.

maya (oncall): incident status: mitigation in place, customer impact reduced to intermittent timeouts from retries. Moving to P1 -> P2 watch. Will keep channel open for 2h for monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged closed? (manual)

maya (oncall): not closed. monitoring window. assigning postmortem lead: kiran. target PMR in 72h.

eva (runtime): logging snippets to include in PMR: 

```
- negotiation_failures_total: 240
- negotiation_failures{reason="tool_support"}: 218
- routing_handoffs_total: 184
- routing_handoff_loop_detected: 12
```

maya (oncall): nice. Ben, any customer asks for hotfix or credits?

ben (support): they asked for ETA on full fix. I'll offer credits for the sustained failure window and follow up with timeline postmortem.

toby (sre): follow ups: add alert for "routing handoff oscillation" (rate of handoffs between two regions > threshold), add auto-disable cross-region fallback for tenants hitting negotiation_failure > X in Y minutes.

kiran (routing): will open infra PRs: policy schema, validation hook, and unit tests. linking docs in thread.

maya (oncall): thanks team. Keep updates here if anything regresses. Closing active mitigation: pinned to v2 and disabled cross-region fallback. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Incident: 2287654321 - mitigation applied at 09:18 UTC, status: monitoring.

---

(After 2h)

maya (oncall): status update: metrics stable for 2h, customer confirms normal ops. Moving to incident review phase. Kiran you own PMR. Add timeline, root cause, mitigations, and follow-up ticket numbers.

kiran (routing): will produce PMR draft. Naming follow-ups: RT-789 (policy validation), RT-790 (catalog feature flags), RT-791 (routing circuit-breaker).

ben (support): customer update sent with ETA for PMR and offered credit.

maya (oncall): thanks all. Closing thread in 24h unless someone needs to reopen."
